name: SQL Injection: Boolean Tautology / OR Clause
description: Detects classic boolean tautology constructs such as OR 1=1 or '1'='1 used to bypass authentication or extract data.

name: SQL Injection: UNION Query Operator
description: Detects UNION SELECT statements commonly employed to exfiltrate database records across different tables.

name: SQL Injection: Administrative/Destructive Commands & Time Delay
description: Detects database modification or time-delay functions (DROP, TRUNCATE, SLEEP, WAITFOR).

name: SQL Injection: Inline Comments & Truncation
description: Detects SQL comment markers (-- or /* */ or #) commonly used to terminate remaining query syntax.

name: XSS: Explicit Script Tag Injection
description: Detects opening and closing script tags or malformed script tags intended to inject arbitrary JavaScript.

name: XSS: Inline Event Handlers
description: Detects HTML event attributes such as onerror, onload, onclick, onmouseover combined with executable code.

name: XSS: JavaScript Pseudoprotocol / DOM Execution
description: Detects javascript: URI schemes and document.cookie / alert execution patterns.

name: LFI: Directory Traversal Sequences
description: Detects dot-dot-slash traversal sequences in standard or encoded formats attempting to escape web roots.

name: LFI: Critical OS File Access
description: Detects direct attempts to target sensitive system files such as /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, win.ini, or boot.ini.

name: Command Injection: Shell Metacharacters & Chaining
description: Detects shell separators (semicolon, pipe, double ampersand) followed by Unix or Windows shell commands.

name: Command Injection: Command Substitution Syntax
description: Detects shell command substitution syntax like $(command) or backtick execution `command`.

name: Reconnaissance: Automated Security Scanner User-Agent
description: Detects automated security scanning tools (sqlmap, nikto, dirbuster, nmap, nuclei, acunetix) based on User-Agent header.

name: Reconnaissance: Sensitive Endpoint Probing
description: Detects scanning for sensitive administrative or configuration artifacts like .git, .env, or phpmyadmin.
